_comment: Project-scoped Claude Code config. Loaded by cloud apps (iOS, Mac, web) that can't reach the user's ~/.claude/. Each project hook script begins with a self-skip preamble: if ~/.claude/hooks/<basename> exists (local CLI), the project copy exits 0 and the user-level master fires. On cloud sandboxes ~/.claude/hooks/ does not exist, so the project copy runs. See .claude/CLOUD.md.
_comment_permissions: Pre-approve claude-code-remote scheduling tools so cloud sessions can self-schedule PR/CI check-ins without hitting an approval wall (send_later was blocked mid-session 2026-07-05). VERIFY the exact tool ids from a cloud session — run the tool once and read the mcp__<server>__<tool> name it reports, then adjust these if the server id differs. Harmless on local CLI where these tools don't exist.
